def ext(frame,ch):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    cs=[(i,j) for i in range(50) for j in range(64) if a[i][j]==ch]
    return (min(i for i,j in cs),max(i for i,j in cs),min(j for i,j in cs),max(j for i,j in cs)) if cs else None
prev=current_frame
for k in range(6):
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':57,'col':42}])
    Y=ext(current_frame,'Y'); N=ext(current_frame,'N')
    ch = Y!=ext(prev,'Y') or N!=ext(prev,'N')
    print('Yright',k+1,'Y',Y,'N',N,'changed' if ch else 'NO')
    prev=current_frame
    if not ch: break
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'): print('DONE');break
